sn56.102:1.1: Then the Buddha, picking up a little bit of dirt on his fingernail, addressed the mendicants:
sn56.102:1.2: “So, mendicants, what do you think: which is more—
sn56.102:1.3: the little bit of dirt I lifted onto my fingernail, or this great earth”?
sn56.102:1.6: The little bit of dirt lifted by the Blessed One onto his fingernail is tiny.
sn56.102:1.7: Compared to the great earth, it doesn’t count, there’s no comparison, it’s not worth a fraction.”
